updater.//: There is no server behind the updater, so a bad release is withdrawn rather than kill-switched — the release and its latest.json are deleted and a fixed one is published (docs/adr/0002-withdraw-bad-releases.md) — which means this address has to be one that always exists, never a per-release URL.
